NIF Lexer — 2027 spec, memfiles + context errors

Imports

ast, ../private/lexutils

Types

NifLexer = ref object
  len*: int
  pos*: int
  line*, col*: int
  current*: char
  strbuf*: string
NifToken = ref object
  kind*: NifTokenKind
  raw*: string
  value*: string
  line*, col*, pos*, wsno*: int
  suffix*: NifSuffix
NifTokenKind = enum
  ntkEof = "<EOF>", ntkLParen = "(", ntkRParen = ")", ntkLBracket = "[",
  ntkRBracket = "]", ntkLBrace = "{", ntkRBrace = "}", ntkDot = "<empty>",
  ntkIdent = "<ident>", ntkSymbol = "<symbol>", ntkSymbolDef = "<symbolDef>",
  ntkInt = "<int>", ntkUInt = "<uint>", ntkFloat = "<float>",
  ntkCharLit = "<charLit>", ntkStrLit = "<strLit>", ntkUnknown = "<unknown>"
